name: daily_demand_by_ba
label: Daily demand and peak by BA
description: Each balancing authority's demand (MWh) and peak hour (MW) per day. For "how did load change", daily load curves, and comparing BAs over a period.

name: data_quality_by_ba
label: Data quality by BA
description: Share of expected hours with valid demand, and how many values were flagged (spikes, zeros) and left out, per balancing authority. For "how reliable is X's data".

name: forecast_accuracy_by_ba
label: Forecast accuracy by BA
description: Day-ahead forecast error (MAPE, %) and bias (MWh) per balancing authority. For "which BA forecasts best/worst"; add order_by on forecast_error_mape.

name: fuel_mix_by_ba
label: Generation mix by BA
description: Generation (MWh) per balancing authority and fuel category (renewable, fossil, nuclear, ...). For "what powers X" and fuel-mix comparisons.

name: monthly_system_peaks
label: Monthly system peaks
description: Coincident (combined) peak demand per month for each interconnection, EIA region and the Lower 48. Filter demand_scope__scope_code to one scope, e.g. US48.
